question.text: Under which section of SEBI Act are monetary penalties imposed on intermediaries for AML/CFT violations as seen in cases like SKSE, Raima, and Shreepati?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XXIV pages 111, 113, and 117, the SKSE Securities, Raima Equities, and Shreepati Holdings AML/CFT penalty orders were imposed under Section 15HB of the SEBI Act, which deals with penalties for contravening any provisions of the Act, rules, regulations, or directions/orders of SEBI. The Trap: Section 11 of the SEBI Act deals with SEBI's powers and functions rather than penalty quantum. Section 24 covers criminal prosecution. Section 12 of PMLA addresses obligations of reporting entities. The cases named in the stem are decided under Section 15HB of the SEBI Act. Note: The Section 15HB attribution here is limited to the three cases named in the stem (SKSE, Raima, Shreepati) per pages 111, 113, and 117.
